thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT INC-2062009876 — sudden KV cache eviction storm in eu-west-1. p99 latency for /v1/generate up ~4x, 5xx spike starting 2026-03-15T01:12Z. Suspect continuous-batching rollout + prefix-hash change. Paging @oncall-sre @irina @sam

oncall-sre: ack. I'm awake, joining. Any impacted customer list?

irina: acmepay and two smaller tenants showing sustained 5xx and degraded throughput. Dashboard: https://app.redwood/internals/metrics?incident=2062009876 (link limited)

sam: logs show rapid kv-prefix eviction for many keys; redis eviction rate jumped, and batch sizes are compressing to 1-2 reqs causing token amplification. Likely regression in the batching allocator that interacts with prefix-key hashing.

jack: noticed a config flip rolled 01:10Z: flag batch.optimizer=enabled + prefix-hash=v2. Could be interaction.

oncall-sre: immediate mitigations: 1) pause batch.optimizer rollout, 2) revert prefix-hash to v1 fallback, 3) scale dedicated pool for eu-west. I'll run commands and report.

oncall-sre: pausing rollout now:
```
redwood-ops rollback feature batch.optimizer --env=prod --region=eu-west-1
```

oncall-sre: applied. Rolling back prefix-hash to legacy fallback for all affected models (hotpatch):
```
PATCH /internal/prefix-hash
Host: infra-api.redwood
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model_glob": "rwd-*",
  "strategy": "legacy-on-mismatch",
  "apply_immediately": true
}
```

sam: I'm scaling pools:
```
infra scale --pool dedicated-eu-west --replicas=8
```

sam: scaled to 8, pods coming up. Also increasing KV cache TTL for prefix entries to reduce churn:
```
redis-cli -h kv-eu setpolicy prefix_ttl 1200
```

irina: applying temporary batch cap (max_tokens_per_batch 512) to limit per-request cost spike.
```
redwood-cli set-config --model rwd-13b --key max_tokens_per_batch --value 512
```

ops-bot: Reaction summary: :hourglass_flowing_sand: mitigations in progress. Alerting customer-success to notify impacted tenants.

customer-success: contacting AcmePay now. ETA for update: 10m. Asking for any workaround (we can suggest retry/backoff).

jack: stacktraces earlier show tokenizer hash mismatches for some templated prompts — template-driven prompt keys were generating different canonical forms (whitespace/newline differences) which v2-hash turned into distinct entries and caused cache blowouts. v1-hash grouped them more conservatively.

nora: we should also add a quick health check to detect rapid prefix-key cardinality increases and auto-fallback. Filing a live action item after stabilization.

oncall-sre: after rollback+scale+ttl changes, error rate dropped within 6 minutes. p99 latency trending down. AcmePay reports reduced errors.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: at 2062011400 severity reduced to SEV2. Monitoring for 30m.

irina: root-cause hypothesis: combo of batch.optimizer (changed batching heuristics) + prefix-hash v2 (more aggressive key-splitting for templated prompts) -> exploded prefix cardinality -> cache eviction storm -> continuous-batching degraded to tiny batches -> perf cliff.

sam: short-term actions (assigned):
- Re-enable conservative batching heuristics while we test optimizer edge cases (assignee: sam)
- Audit template canonicalization (assignee: jack)
- Add prefix-cardinality alert and auto-fallback (assignee: nora)
- Customer comms follow-up with CSP (assignee: customer-success)

jack: I pushed a hotfix to tokenizer canonicalizer to normalize whitespace/newlines in templated prompts. Will run canary against a small traffic slice.

irina: we need a postmortem with timeline, impact calc (tokens, requests, customers impacted), and clear rollout checklist for hash/optimizer features. I'll own the postmortem.

customer-success: AcmePay on a call, they said calls recovered and they're putting extra monitoring. Will send minutes.

oncall-sre: closing incident channel to incident-updates; keeping watch. If anything regresses, reopen thread.

ops-bot: Action items recorded: https://jira.redwood/browse/INC-2062009876-actions. Postmortem requested, target ETA 2026-03-17.

nora: note for postmortem — include regression test that exercises templated prompts with different whitespace/linebreaks and validate prefix-hash stability across tokenizer versions.

irina: thanks team. Good coordination. I'll create the postmortem doc and ping when draft ready.

ops-bot: :lock: Incident resolved -> de-escalated at 2062013600.
